title: useful in many ways, not just name cards
text:
useful in many ways, not just name cards. I actually bought these to use as food info cards at family buffets,etc... not name/place cards... They work very well. They are silver.. sturdy and a bit weighted at the bottom, but not too much. They do stand up. They are just about the right height at about 2 3/4" from top to bottom. They are chrome or stainless color... but it is not noted on the box so they probably are not either. They do wash up, I just wipe off if they become messy. The base is about 1" in circumference.. in case that helps. I bought some "name" cards to slide in... and that works. But you could buy some card stock or even recipe cards and cut your own. I will update if there any use issues. They arrived quickly (I have prime) and in good condition.
Gee... if there is anything other info I can provide that would be more helpful, please let me know. I do the best I can to be honest and fair. I PAY for these items, I am NOT a "paid" reviewer. I am just a "top" reviewer... .still honest... still human. :)
